_about: Frozen ellipse for the scorecard's ellipse fraction (issue #4). The scorecard looks up its test set by fingerprint; a test set not listed here gets the provisional fallback axes and is flagged provisional. Changing a frozen entry means a deliberate new test-set definition: add a new entry, do not edit an old one.

training_v3.plane: (100 r_trueE, 100 r_trueLepE), test set, true trueE in [0.5, 6] GeV, inside if (x/a)^2 + (y/b)^2 <= 1

calibration.target: baseline r05 sample 3 at about 60-70% inside
